learningObjective: Trace greedy non-maximum suppression from overlapping scored boxes to one retained detection while understanding why selection order matters.
mediumRationale: A deterministic before, select, suppress, and result SVG can reuse the same box coordinates across stages. Mermaid cannot express IoU overlap geometry, and interaction is unnecessary for the first version.

pages.insight: The computer-vision overview situates object detection and segmentation as localization tasks beyond image classification.
The Faster R-CNN slide provides the proposal and detection context in which anchors and NMS operate.

deckReview.notes: The deck has detection context but no accessible stepwise NMS teaching figure. The agent's two-figure proposal was narrowed to greedy suppression, the less intuitive algorithm.
